name: HackTool - RemoteKrbRelay Execution
description: Detects the use of RemoteKrbRelay, a Kerberos relaying tool via CommandLine flags and PE metadata.
author: GAI_CTI
query: (process.executable:*\\RemoteKrbRelay.exe OR process.pe.original_file_name:RemoteKrbRelay.exe) OR (process.command_line:*\ \-clsid\ * AND process.command_line:*\ \-target\ * AND process.command_line:*\ \-victim\ *) OR (process.command_line:*\-rbcd\ * AND (process.command_line:(*\-cn\ * OR *\-\-computername\ *))) OR (process.command_line:*\-chp\ * AND (process.command_line:*\-chpPass\ * AND process.command_line:*\-chpUser\ *)) OR (process.command_line:*\-addgroupmember\ * AND process.command_line:*\-group\ * AND process.command_line:*\-groupuser\ *) OR ((process.command_line:*\-smb\ * AND process.command_line:*\-\-smbkeyword\ *) AND (process.command_line:(*interactive* OR *secrets* OR *service\-add*)))
